title: Cyberwave Twin Battery Status
description: A robot's own reading of its main battery. Published on {prefix}cyberwave/twin/{twin_uuid}/battery/status. A publisher that cannot report a percentage (e.g. an ArduPilot battery monitor with no configured capacity) publishes nothing here rather than a placeholder. Identified by its topic, not by a field: the payload carries no contract id.

source_type.description: Runtime that produced the reading: edge for a real battery, sim for a simulated one. Same vocabulary as source_type.envelope.v1.

timestamp.description: Unix time in seconds at which the reading was taken.

session_id.description: Driver session the reading belongs to, when the driver runs inside one; absent or null outside one.

percentage.description: Remaining charge in percent, 0 to 100. Not a 0-1 fraction: a value in that range reads as a nearly flat battery.

voltage.description: Pack voltage in volts. Omitted when unknown; publishers should not send 0 as a placeholder.
